task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Tokyo and convert 22°C to Fahrenheit, then look up the status of flight AA100. After that, scan the living room devices, find the smart lock and lock it with PIN 2026, then get the living room light’s current state and dim it to 20% brightness, set the living room AC temperature to 22, and finally send me a high-priority app alert saying: “Departure routine completed: flight checked, doors locked, lights dimmed, and AC adjusted.”

user_input.query: For user traveler_01, please check the weather in Tokyo and convert 22°C to Fahrenheit, then look up the status of flight AA100. After that, scan the devices in the living_room, find the smart lock with lock_id lock_main, and lock it using PIN 2026. Then check the current state of the living room light with device ID light_living and dim it to 20% brightness. Also set the living room AC with device_id ac_living to 22. Finally, send me a high-priority app alert that says: “Departure routine completed: flight checked, doors locked, lights dimmed, and AC adjusted.”
